title: The Witness of the Marlowe Estate Revisited
author: Ivo Sterling
blurb: Theo Fairweather, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
